title: Austin Hospital Authority & Brackenridge Transfer
summary:
*   The Austin City Council approved the creation of the Austin Hospital Authority, a new entity to manage local hospital operations.
*   This new authority is specifically tasked with planning and executing the transfer of Brackenridge Hospital's operations.
*   Initial funding of up to $818,500 was authorized for legal, due diligence, and other expenses related to this significant hospital transition.
*   The council also voted to reduce the number of board members for the new hospital authority from nine to seven, with an emphasis on including an individual with extensive financial experience.
